title: A Steady Hand
body: Null Meridian Labs never chased the biggest headline. Trust held, the safety backlog stayed manageable, and the board learned to live with a company that says no sometimes. Nobody wrote a movie about you. That was rather the point.

title: Runaway Growth
body: The models shipped, the users came, and the cash kept moving. Somewhere in the growth curve, a few safety reviews got shorter than anyone would admit out loud. The company is bigger now. Whether it is better is a question for the next quarter.

title: Grounded Struggle
body: It was a hard thirty days: a cramped office, a skeptical public, a rival that never slowed down. Null Meridian Labs is still standing, bruised and undercapitalized, having learned exactly how unforgiving this industry can be to a small team with good intentions.
